security_audit.summary: I found no evidence of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or malicious command execution. Most detections are Markdown examples or file references; the remaining concern is that three scripts can overwrite a user-selected output file.

remediation.issue: Scripts overwrite a user-supplied --output path without checking existing files.
remediation.suggestion: Resolve output paths inside the current workspace, refuse sensitive paths, and ask before overwriting existing files.

remediation.issue: Documentation shows setup and deployment commands without safety warnings.
remediation.suggestion: Add notes that users should verify targets, credentials, and environments before install or deployment commands run.

content.user_title: Build Fullstack Apps With Senior Guidance
content.value_statement: Teams need consistent structure when building fullstack applications. This skill provides scaffolding guidance, stack references, workflow notes, and simple quality reports for AI-assisted development.
actual_capabilities: Provides Python scripts for project scaffolding, fullstack checks, and code quality reporting.
Validates target paths before running analysis or report generation.
Can print JSON results or write them to a chosen output file.
Documents React, Next.js, Node.js, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud workflow topics.
Provides reference sections for architecture patterns, development workflows, security practices, and troubleshooting.
limitations: The included scripts are lightweight templates and do not generate a complete application by themselves.
The scripts only write output files when a user or agent provides an output path.
Reference files contain generic guidance and should be adapted to the project.
It does not replace security review, dependency auditing, or production readiness testing.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Product Build
use_cases.description: Create an initial fullstack project plan and choose a practical stack for a new web product.

use_cases.title: Review Project Direction
use_cases.description: Check project structure, workflows, and quality practices before expanding a team codebase.

use_cases.title: Standardize Delivery Workflows
use_cases.description: Align setup, quality checks, and deployment references across multiple application teams.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Fullstack Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the senior-fullstack skill to outline a React, Next.js, Node.js, GraphQL, and PostgreSQL project setup for [product]. Include folder structure, setup commands, and first tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Review My App Structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [path] with the code quality analyzer and summarize structure, missing tests, security gaps, and practical next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Production Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Using the development workflow references, create a CI, deployment, monitoring, and rollback workflow for [application]. Match it to [cloud provider] and [team size].

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Multi-Service Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the architecture and tech stack references to compare monolith, modular monolith, and service-based options for [system]. Include data ownership, API contracts, risks, and migration steps.

output_examples.input: Plan a new customer portal with React, Next.js, Node.js, GraphQL, and PostgreSQL.
output_examples.output: A structured build plan with recommended folders, core services, database concerns, setup commands, and first implementation tasks.

output_examples.input: Review my existing app before adding payments and admin workflows.
output_examples.output: A practical review covering project structure, missing quality checks, likely security concerns, and prioritized next steps.

output_examples.input: Create a deployment workflow for a small team using Docker and Kubernetes.
output_examples.output: A delivery workflow covering local setup, CI checks, image build steps, deployment review, monitoring, and rollback planning.

best_practices: Run scripts against a project copy or review outputs before applying recommendations.
Use the references as checklists, then adapt stack choices to team experience and operational constraints.
Pair generated recommendations with tests, dependency review, and human code review.
anti_patterns: Do not run setup or deployment commands in production without confirming targets and credentials.
Do not treat placeholder reference content as a complete architecture decision.
Do not let the agent overwrite important files through an output path without review.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps plan and review fullstack web applications using common React, Next.js, Node.js, GraphQL, and PostgreSQL patterns.

faq.question: Does it create a complete application?
faq.answer: No. The included scripts are simple templates, so users should expect guidance and lightweight reports, not a finished product.

faq.question: Can it analyze an existing repository?
faq.answer: Yes. The scripts accept a target path and produce a basic status report for the selected project.

faq.question: Can it write files?
faq.answer: Yes. The scripts can write JSON output when an output path is provided, so users should review the destination first.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Should teams still run security checks?
faq.answer: Yes. This skill provides guidance, but teams still need dependency audits, secret scanning, tests, and production security review.
